rationale: The message reports completed probe findings and concrete conversion/parsing outputs, so its main function is delivering results. It also provides factual observations about HCL behavior and error format.

evidence.text: HCL probes: -cj parses attrs and nested blocks: `resource "aws_instance" "x" { ami="abc" count=2 }` -> {"resource":[{"aws_instance":[{"x":[{"ami":"abc","count":2}]}]}]}.

-jc emits quoted keys, blank line between attrs: {"foo":"bar","n":1,"xs":[true,"x"]} -> `"foo" = "bar"

"n" = 1

"xs" = ["x"]` (bool in array dropped oddly); maps emit nested braces.
HCL errors prefix `Error parsing HCL: ...`; -cc converts to quoted-key HCL.
